note: Marker that flags this as a T4 repo — the hooks fire only when this file is present, so they never touch a non-T4 repo. "verify" is the repo's FAST unit suite, timed at 38s (1050 passed) on 2026-08-09 — the full ./code_quality_checks.sh fails on this Windows box because the checkout uses .venv not .pal_venv (known ledger item), so the unit suite alone is wired and the formatters are left to /simplify. t4-gate RUNS it before `gh pr merge` and blocks on failure. Empty = off; keep it in sync with CI. Set "requireGreenCI" true to also block `gh pr merge` while any server-side check is failing or pending. Set "autoMerge" (or "afk") true during an unattended run so `gh pr merge` doesn't stop to ask for review confirmation — the verify deny still applies. "afk": true additionally lets the gate permit `git reset --hard`/`git clean` for reverting a parked item to green (force-push and `branch -D` stay blocked).
